description: Governed document ingestion — ingest a document into governed retrieval. Accepts raw text OR a base64-encoded file (PDF, DOCX, TXT, images). Hybrid extraction: text path first for cost efficiency, automatic Claude vision fallback for scanned/image-only PDFs (< 30 words/page triggers fallback). Content is chunked, embedded, hash-verified, and stored with full audit trail. Each chunk gets SHA-256 integrity hash. Classification: ADVISORY — creates governed content, audited.

allowed_roles.description: Roles allowed to retrieve this document

classification.description: Document classification. Controls which retrievals can surface it when a classification floor is in force (MANDATORY > ADVISORY > INFORMATIONAL). Defaults to ADVISORY.

content.description: Full text content to ingest (use this OR file_base64, not both)

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded file content — PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV, or image (PNG/JPG/WEBP/GIF). Hybrid extraction: text extraction attempted first (cheap), Claude vision fallback triggered automatically for scanned PDFs with < 30 words/page.

file_mime_type.description: MIME type for file_base64 (e.g. application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, image/png). Helps the server pick the right extractor.

filename.description: Original filename including extension — used to resolve format when mime type is ambiguous (e.g. document.pdf, report.docx)

name: gia_ingest_document
